description: This is a rectangular rug with a complex geometric pattern. The base color is a creamy off-white, and it is adorned with intricate designs in shades of coral pink, deep navy blue, and hints of yellow. The border features a repeating motif of stylized floral or leaf shapes in coral and blue, framed by thinner lines of contrasting colors. The central field of the rug is filled with a repeating arrangement of diamond shapes and smaller floral elements, all rendered in the same color palette. The edges of the rug are finished with a fringe of white or cream threads. The overall impression is one of traditional craftsmanship and detailed artistry.
